command:

test "$(cat /opt/odin-transfer/notices-package-job.exit)" = 0
python3 - <<'PY'
import base64,gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib
path=pathlib.Path('/opt/odin-notice-export/manifest-0fe03ba.json')
data=path.read_bytes();manifest=json.loads(data)
